description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named List13, which demonstrates efficient list handling by avoiding expensive view binding operations during list scrolls and flings. It includes an internal class SlowAdapter that manages views based on the scrolling state, showing 'Loading...' during scrolling and actual data when idle. The activity sets up a ListView with this adapter and manages scroll state changes to optimize performance.

classes.description: An activity demonstrating list performance optimization by conditionally binding data based on scrolling state.

classes.description: A custom adapter that delays data binding during scrolls or flings to improve performance.
